name: [⛏️] Refinery Caves 2
desc:
Welcome to Refinery Caves 2, a game about exploring the world and improving your base with the extended building system.

-----------

⛏️ Mine Ores.
🪓 Chop Trees.
🎣 Catch Fish.

Whatever you like!

Inspired by Defaultio's Lumber Tycoon 2 and Refinery Caves 1.
